lat: 3tit l-flus l khuya l-bare7
en: I gave the money to my brother yesterday.

lat: ma 3titsh s-sarut l weld 3mmi
en: I didn't give the key to my cousin.

lat: 3titi l-ktab l sa7bek l-bare7
en: You gave the book to your friend yesterday.

lat: ma 3titish n-nmra dyalek l l-bulis
en: You didn't give your number to the police.

lat: 3titi l-werqa l khtek s-sghira
en: You gave the paper to your little sister.

lat: ma 3titish l-flus l mmek
en: You (f.) didn't give the money to your mother.

lat: huwa 3ta l-kebbut dyalu l sa7bu
en: He gave his coat to his friend.

lat: ma 3tash r-ray dyalu f l-ijtima3
en: He didn't give his opinion in the meeting.

lat: hiya 3tat l-makla l l-qetta dyalha
en: She gave food to her cat.

lat: ma 3tatsh l-7elwa l d-drari
en: She didn't give sweets to the children.

lat: 3tina l-khedma l wa7ed rajel kbir f s-senn
ar: عطينا الخدمة لواحد راجل كبير فالسن
en: We gave the job to an old man.

lat: ma 3tinash l-3enwan l hadak l-berrani
en: We didn't give the address to that stranger.

lat: ntuma 3titu hadiya kbira l waldikum
en: You gave a big gift to your parents.

lat: ma 3titush l-jawab l l-mudir
en: You didn't give the answer to the director.

lat: huma 3taw l-flus l j-jm3iya
en: They gave the money to the association.

lat: ma 3tawsh l-forssa l had l-weld
en: They didn't give the chance to this boy.

lat: dima kan3ti l-makla l l-7mam
en: I always give food to the pigeons.

lat: ma kan3tish s-sarut dyali l 7etta wa7ed
ar: ما كنعطيش الساروت ديالي لحتى واحد
en: I don't give my key to anyone.

lat: kat3ti n-nasi7a l s-s7ab dyalek
en: You give advice to your friends.

lat: ma kat3tish l-flus l sa7bek
en: You do not give money to your friend.

lat: kat3ti l-werqa l l-mu3ellima
en: You give the paper to the teacher.

lat: ma kat3tish r-ray dyalek b z-zerba
en: You don't give your opinion quickly.

lat: kay3ti l-keswa l n-nas l-m7tajin
en: He gives clothes to people in need.

lat: huwa ma kay3tish l-flus l kul wa7ed
ar: هو ما كيعطيش الفلوس لكل واحد
en: He doesn't give money to everyone.

lat: hiya kat3ti d-dwa l mha kul sba7
ar: هي كتعطي الدوا لمها كل صباح
en: She gives medicine to her mother every morning.

lat: ma kat3tish l-ahmiya l had l-hedra
en: She doesn't give importance to this talk.

lat: kul 3am kan3tiw l-kteb l l-mdrasa
en: Every year we give books to the school.

lat: 7na ma kan3tiwsh n-nmra dyalna l l-berraniyin
ar: حنا ما كنعطيوش النمرة ديالنا للبرانيين
en: We don't give our number to strangers.

lat: kat3tiw l-khubz l n-nas kul nhar
en: You give bread to people every day.

lat: ma kat3tiwsh l-weqt l l-qraya dyalkum
en: You don't give time to your studies.

lat: kay3tiw l-khedma l sh-shebbab hna
en: They give work to the youth here.

lat: ma kay3tiwsh l-wraq dyal l-iqama daba
ar: ما كيعطيوش الوراق ديال الإقامة دابا
en: They don't give residency papers now.

lat: ghedda ghadi n3ti s-sarut l j-jar
en: Tomorrow I am going to give the key to the neighbor.

lat: ma ghadish n3ti t-tumubil dyali l 7ed
ar: ما غاديش نعطي الطوموبيل ديالي لحد
en: I am not going to give my car to anyone.

lat: wash ghadi t3ti l-werqa l l-idara
en: Are you going to give the paper to the administration?

lat: nta ma ghadish t3ti l-flus l hadak sh-sheffar
ar: نتا ما غاديش تعطي الفلوس لهاداك الشفار
en: You are not going to give money to that thief.

lat: nti ghadi t3ti hadiya l khtek
en: You are going to give a gift to your sister.

lat: ma ghadish t3ti had l-ktab l sa7ebtek
ar: ما غاديش تعطي هاد الكتاب لصاحبتك
en: You are not going to give this book to your friend.

lat: huwa ghadi y3ti l-jawaz dyalu l l-bulis
ar: هو غادي يعطي الجواز ديالو للبوليس
en: He is going to give his passport to the police.

lat: ma ghadish y3ti l-kelma dyalu l had r-rajel
ar: ما غاديش يعطي الكلمة ديالو لهاد الراجل
en: He is not going to give his word to this man.

lat: hiya ghadi t3ti l-werqa l l-mudir ghedda
ar: هي غادي تعطي الورقة للمدير غدا
en: She is going to give the paper to the director tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish t3ti d-dwa l l-weld daba
ar: ما غاديش تعطي الدوا للولد دابا
en: She is not going to give the medicine to the boy now.

lat: 7na ghadi n3tiw l-musa3ada l l-jiran
en: We are going to give help to the neighbors.

lat: ma ghadish n3tiw l-flus l hadak mul l-7anut
ar: ما غاديش نعطيو الفلوس لهاداك مول الحانوت
en: We are not going to give money to that shopkeeper.

lat: ntuma ghadi t3tiw l-kora l khuya
en: You (pl.) are going to give the ball to my brother.

lat: ma ghadish t3tiw s-sarut l 7etta wa7ed
ar: ما غاديش تعطيو الساروت لحتى واحد
en: You are not going to give the key to anyone.

lat: ghadi y3tiw s-sarut l khuya
en: They will give the key to my brother.

lat: ma ghadish y3tiw l-khbar l n-nas daba
ar: ما غاديش يعطيو الخبار للناس دابا
en: They are not going to give the news to the people now.
